_about: Zone limits with the clause each number comes from (register: envelope; condition z_envelope) and loading (register: component_space sources vanParking5, edmZB580). site.js ZV, ZE, loadingNeed. Each row's src covers its numbers; the clause text ('cl') names the section. Build 2 (3 Nov 2026, part 7): rows for every zone in checks/research_arch_v1/zones.md where a data centre is permitted, conditional or discretionary (register patch zones_2026_11_03.py); FC-2 by sub-area ('FC-2 A' … 'FC-2 E'); 'q' lists fields the by-law does not give ('?'), for which the tool borrows IM limits only to draw, labelled.
